FIELDS.NAME: The Fresh Bagel Bakery
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
The Fresh Bagel Bakery specializes in the artisanal production of fresh bagels and baked goods, utilizing traditional baking techniques combined with modern culinary practices. Our dedicated team bakes on-site each morning, ensuring all products are made from high-quality ingredients sourced from reputable suppliers. We adhere rigorously to food safety standards, including maintaining a documented food safety program compliant with ServSafe guidelines. The bakery is equipped with automatic fire suppression systems and monitored alarm systems to enhance safety for both our employees and customers. We also offer online ordering options, implementing robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data. With a focus on providing a warm, inviting atmosphere, we serve a diverse range of baked goods and bagels to our community, while upholding a strong commitment to sanitation and operational excellence.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms full compliance with safety regulations, including the installation of automatic extinguishing systems over all cooking equipment. We maintain monitored fire and burglar alarm systems at all locations and have documented food safety programs, with all staff holding ServSafe certifications. Additionally, we consistently uphold proper sanitation and refrigeration controls to ensure the highest standards of food safety and quality.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, we experienced a water damage incident due to a burst pipe in the storage area, resulting in the loss of $1,500 in inventory and repair costs. Status: Resolved. On 08/10/2023, a small electrical fire occurred in the kitchen, leading to damages worth $500. The fire was quickly extinguished, and no injuries were reported. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Automatic extinguishing systems; Class B safe; UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security fencing and periodic patrols by trained watchpersons to enhance perimeter security and deter theft.
